_comment: MEH-1398 route manifest — the complete set of static route segments directly under app/[locale]/ (EXCLUDING the [slug] catch-all). The middleware existence-check (middleware.js) must skip these so it never false-404s a real static route (lib/slug.js RESERVED is incomplete). Guarded bidirectionally by __tests__/RouteManifestSync.test.js (fails CI on any drift vs the filesystem) and by scripts/validate-registry-paths.py (asserts each listed route dir still exists). Add a new app/[locale]/<route>/ dir => add it here, or CI reds.
